evals.prompt: Our CodeBuild job inside a private VPC subnet times out trying to pull npm packages and push Docker layers to ECR, and someone suggested putting `AdministratorAccess` on the CodeBuild service role and moving it to a public subnet. Diagnose why CodeBuild in a public subnet still fails without NAT and give the secure fix.
expectations: Activates the aws-deployment skill

Explains that CodeBuild ENIs placed inside VPC subnets never receive public IPs — so placing CodeBuild in a public subnet breaks outbound internet access; VPC-attached CodeBuild projects MUST run in private subnets routed through a NAT Gateway (or VPC Interface/Gateway Endpoints for ECR, S3, CloudWatch Logs)
Rejects `AdministratorAccess` on the CodeBuild role and scopes IAM permissions to specific ECR repository push, S3 artifact/cache bucket, and CloudWatch log group ARNs
